response.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_media) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_media p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.avg_bytes_per_ms DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each media type's average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes divided by total milliseconds), computed over tracks with Bytes > 10323804.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages, as the request states, over media types that have at least one qualifying track.
